source: User-supplied coastal portrait of Nishabh Polke
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: illustrated portrait for Nishabh Polke's portfolio homepage.
Input image 1 is the edit target and identity reference. Transform this exact man into a polished hand-drawn editorial illustration. Preserve his recognizable face, windswept dark hair with lighter streaks, clear-frame glasses, beard, smiling expression, small earring, chain necklace, dark open jacket, T-shirt, and white tote bag strap. Preserve the three-quarter pose looking toward the left.
Style: expressive black ink contours with subtle pencil hatching and flat restrained grayscale shading. Clearly an illustration, not a photo or photographic filter. Refined and personable, with natural human proportions and carefully observed likeness. No cartoon exaggeration.
Composition: vertical 4:5 portrait, waist-up, centered in frame, full hair and shoulders visible with modest breathing room above and on both sides. Subject occupies most of the canvas. Remove the coast and sky completely; use a uniform pale cool gray background #f5f5f7 that suits a minimal monochrome portfolio. Opaque background. No border, text, labels, decorative shapes, scenery, logos, or watermark.
